headline: Patreon vs Ko-fi vs Buy Me a Coffee
description: Compare creator platform commissions and processing estimates for Patreon, Ko-fi, and Buy Me a Coffee—with worked pledge math and when each platform wins.

itemListElement.name: Patreon vs Ko-fi vs Buy Me a Coffee

mainEntity.name: Which creator platform takes the least?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often Ko-fi Gold for donations when commission is removed and only processing-like fees remain, but processing and payout rails still apply. On free Ko-fi or BMAC, planning takes near 5% (BMAC also +$0.30) can beat higher Patreon plan blends—verify current policies on official pricing pages.

mainEntity.name: Should I multi-home on several platforms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Possible, but fragmented memberships confuse fans and split messaging. Pick a primary home for recurring support and treat secondary buttons as overflow, not three equal memberships.

Our calculators use blended planning estimates that include platform and typical processing effects for forecasting. Your Patreon statements may show separate lines. Treat blends as planning tools and spot-check against payouts.

mainEntity.name: When does Ko-fi Gold pay for itself?

acceptedAnswer.text: When the donation commission you remove exceeds Gold’s cost at your monthly tip volume, after still paying processing. Run the arithmetic with your real monthly tips and current Gold pricing from Ko-fi.

mainEntity.name: How do I compare a $10 tier across platforms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Enter $10 in each of /tools/patreon-fee-calculator/, /tools/kofi-fee-calculator/, and /tools/buy-me-a-coffee-fee-calculator/ on the correct schedule, then compare net and effective percent. Multiply by patron count for monthly forecasts.
